```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="sliding_door_cabinet">

  <!-- Cabinet carcass: 1.75 m wide (X), 0.34 m deep (Y), 1.05 m tall (Z).
       Front face at y = -0.15, back at y = +0.19. Doors add 0.04 m in front,
       giving a total depth of 0.38 m. -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.02 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.75 0.34 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.02 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.75 0.34 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.02 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="40.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="4.06033" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="13.88333" iyz="0.0"
               izz="10.59367"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Left sliding door, front track (y = -0.19 .. -0.17).
       Closed: spans x = -0.875 .. 0.025. Slides +X to open. -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 1.00"/>
      </geometry>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 1.00"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.416833" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.754167" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.337667"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Right sliding door, rear track (y = -0.17 .. -0.15).
       Closed: spans x = -0.025 .. 0.875. Slides -X to open. -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 1.00"/>
      </geometry>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 1.00"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.416833" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.754167" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.337667"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Left door joint: prismatic along X, slides to the right (+X). -->
  <joint name="joint_door_left" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.425 -0.18 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.90" effort="50.0" velocity="0.5"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Right door joint: prismatic along X, slides to the left (-X). -->
  <joint name="joint_door_right" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.425 -0.16 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.90" upper="0.0" effort="50.0" velocity="0.5"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
